decisions.reason: Its disappearance from the website by 2024 suggests the evening psychiatric day-patient program did not show enough traction to justify further specialized staffing and coordination costs, so the option value now looks largely exhausted.

The outpatient sociotherapy service moved from a simple mention to the home page, indicating rising strategic importance in a field close to the firm's core mental health capabilities, so it remains a valuable option to scale.

Being featured on the home page in both years signals sustained demand and fit with the firm's eldercare offering, so management would keep investing while uncertainty appears to be resolving positively.
The retail shop progressed to home-page visibility and complements the sheltered workshop and inclusion mission, so the product still offers upside with acceptable continuation costs.
